blocks.x: Maybe that island off the coast off New England isn’t haunted after all. In its first season Widow’s Bay was the biggest success of the Emmy Awards, taking home six trophies at the main ceremony Monday night, earning wins for Matthew Rhys, Kate O’Flynn, Stephen Root, Kate Dippold’s writing, Hiro Murai’s direction, and Outstanding Comedy Series. That’s on top of the eight Emmys the show won at the Creative Arts Emmys last weekend, bringing the show to 14 trophies in its freshman outing.

Elsewhere, it was still good to work at The Pitt (the TV show, not the emergency room), though perhaps not as acclaimed as it was last year. Noah Wyle still pulled out the award for Best Actor in a Drama and the show earned the big award for Outstanding Drama, but missed out on the rest of its nominations tonight. Jean Smart and Matthew Rhys also both had great, historic nights, while Pluribus came out looking pretty great, too. Take a look at all the winners below.
